content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Andaman and Nicobar Administration Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.andaman.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 18-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Assistant Engineer post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Assistant Engineer post is 18 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Engineer position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognized University with computer knowledge. A Degree in Civil Engineering is considered desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Engineer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 22,000 per month for the contract period.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Assistant Engineer post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Assistant Engineer post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve the creation of a Merit List, followed by an Interview, and finally Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the type of job offered?
faq.answer: The job is offered on a Contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Assistant Engineer post.

faq.question: Q9. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in Offline mode by sending the application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Andaman and Nicobar Administration, which is www.andaman.gov.in.
